purpose: Self-contained 3-context model-based property-test file for three DISTINCT pubkeys A/B/C. S1 lands only the skeleton: ModelState3P, RealSystem3P, beforeAll/afterAll lifecycle, and exactly one placeholder test under one test.describe.serial. Commands and assertions land in S2-S5.

public_api.name: test (discovered)
public_api.signature: test.describe.serial("[C0,S5,S6,S7,S10,A7-A12,A14] 3-party multi-user property", () => test("[C0,S5,S6,S7,S10] settled-state equality holds across A/B/C", ...))
public_api.description: Exactly one Playwright test under one serial describe. Body is a minimal placeholder in S1 (test.skip on mobile + trivial body). Wired with the full fc.commands property in S5.

public_api.name: ModelState3P
public_api.signature: class ModelState3P { groupId/groupName: string|null; pubkeyA/B/C: string|null; memberA/B/C: boolean; tasks: Map<string, ModelTask3P>; epochSequenceA/B/C: number[]; lastSwitched; pubkey(actor): string|null; actorIsMember(actor): boolean; recordEpoch(actor, n: number|null): void; reset(): void }
public_api.description: Expected-state model for the property machine. Single shared group, three distinct per-actor pubkeys, per-actor membership + epoch sequences. NO multi-device same-pubkey state (contrast multi-user-md). Consumed by S2-S5 command/assertion classes within this file only.

public_api.name: RealSystem3P
public_api.signature: class RealSystem3P { readonly pageA/pageB/pageC: Page; page(actor: "A"|"B"|"C"): Page; getTasks(actor): Promise<Map<string, ModelTask3P>>; getTask(actor, id): Promise<ModelTask3P|undefined>; quiesce(): Promise<void> }
public_api.description: Wraps three Playwright pages. page() accessor + getTasks/getTask/quiesce readers implemented in S1 (they are stable and used by S2-S5). Command-dispatch methods are added by S2/S3 directly as command classes, not as RealSystem3P methods (mirrors 2-party + md templates).
